description: C1's redesign (behavioral-spec.md:54-65) declares the old 'pre-synthesized one-way clip + escalate-on-interaction' voice design SUPERSEDED (explicitly stated at behavioral-spec.md:108, OQ1: "The prior 'pre-synthesized one-way clip' is SUPERSEDED (it was not a conversation)"). But that SUPERSEDED design is not a historical artifact — it is LIVE, CURRENT, DEPLOYED code: apps/life-call/lib/voice-cheap.js (planVoice()/chooseTts()) is imported by server.js:29 and drives the exact behavior the spec calls wrong (planVoice() returns {mode:'live_escalation', opensLiveWs:true} on any caller interaction; TTS_ORDER includes 'live' as a fallback). apps/life-call/lib/voice-cheap.test.js (currently GREEN, wired into the canonical `npm test` script at package.json:9) asserts this exact superseded behavior at lines 37-41 ('planVoice: caller speaks OR presses key -> live escalation ... opensLiveWs, true'). C1's text names only server.js:447 (the DTMF trigger) and the abstract function name 'openGeminiLive()' as things to delete; it never names voice-cheap.js, voice-cheap.test.js, or voice-synth.cjs, and never instructs their deletion/replacement/reconciliation. An implementer following C1 literally could delete server.js:447's DTMF call and still leave voice-cheap.js's planVoice()/chooseTts() (and its currently-passing contradictory test) intact and importable, producing a test suite that asserts two irreconcilable invariants (old: interaction/synth-failure -> opensLiveWs:true; new: live_ws_opened=0 on the normal path including DTMF, Live gated behind an explicit off-by-default LM_VOICE_EMERGENCY_LIVE=1 flag) with no spec-mandated resolution.

evidence.description: C1's 'GEMINI LIVE FULLY REMOVED' bullet names only server.js:447 and 'openGeminiLive()' as the things deleted; it never mentions voice-cheap.js/voice-cheap.test.js/voice-synth.cjs, so the migration of the currently-live superseded module is unaddressed.
